lastCompletedStory.title: Boot prompt + persona derive backlog via cam issue list; greeting counts line

nextStoryContext: US-004 shipped: buildOrchestratorBootPrompt() (src/commands/run.ts) now instructs deriving the backlog via the real `cam issue list` shell command, with an explicit fallback to reading scripts/cam/issues/*.json filtered by stage (exclude shipped/abandoned) when the command is unavailable or exits non-zero. The orchestrator persona (.claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md AND templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md, edited identically per CAM-123 self-hosting) gained: (a) boot-context step 5 (renumbered from the old step 5/6 -> now 6/7) with the same derivation+fallback rule; (b) a `backlog: <N idea | N specified | N planned>` line in the one-screen greeting template plus an explicit sentence 'Do NOT enumerate individual issues in the greeting -- no per-issue list, ever.' (the literal string 'no per-issue list' is what the doc-gate test greps for); (c) the conversation-contract row for any backlog question now reads 'Run `cam issue list` fresh -- never answer from memory or from the handoff.' (the literal string 'never answer from memory or from the handoff' is what the doc-gate test greps for). cam-issue.md's stale 'tracked separately (CAM-74)' note is replaced with a real `cam issue list` invocation block (both copies). New test/vendor/orchestrator-backlog-derivation.test.ts (doc-gate, mirrors cam-ship-hygiene.test.ts) asserts over BOTH buildOrchestratorBootPrompt() and templatesContents['agents/subagent-orchestrator.md']: 'cam issue list' present, 'scripts/cam/issues/*.json' + 'filtered by stage' present (fallback), 'backlog:' + 'no per-issue list' present (greeting no-enumeration), 'cam issue list' + 'never answer from memory or from the handoff' present (conversation contract). US-005 (next, per its own notes) explicitly says to EXTEND this same test file, not create a second one -- add new test cases to the existing describe blocks or a new describe block in the same file. US-005 touches scripts/cam/orch-handoff.schema.json (no templates/ counterpart -- only the single file) redefining nextActions as ephemeral cycle-specific-only (never a backlog snapshot) plus a hard rule that no handoff field enumerates the backlog, and extends the persona's self-handoff lifecycle section (~old line 292, now shifted by ~+8 lines from this story's edits -- re-grep for 'Write the handoff first' rather than trusting the old line number) with the same nextActions-ephemeral + no-backlog-in-handoff rules. Re-verify CAM-123 dual-copy byte-identity on the persona files before editing (they were byte-identical again immediately after this story's cp-sync).
